[Thinking]
**Exploring Brand Websites**

I'm currently investigating prominent office furniture brands, systematically collecting their official web presences. My focus is on identifying those that offer comprehensive product catalogs and user-friendly browsing experiences.

**Categorizing Office Furniture**

I'm refining my approach to segmenting the office furniture market, moving from broad exploration to specific brand identification across premium, mid-range, D2C, and budget tiers. My aim is to build a structured list for deeper analysis.

**Compiling Brand Information**

I'm actively gathering key brands like IKEA Business and Vari, noting their primary web domains. This stage is crucial for building out the structured categories I've outlined, ensuring comprehensive coverage.
[/Thinking]

Here is a categorized list of some of the most popular and reputable office furniture brand websites, ranging from premium corporate suppliers to direct-to-consumer home office brands.

### 1. The Premium "Big Four" (Commercial & High-End Ergonomics)
These brands are the industry leaders, known for furnishing Fortune 500 companies and creating iconic, highly researched ergonomic chairs (like the Aeron or Leap styles).
*   **Steelcase:** [steelcase.com](https://www.steelcase.com/)
*   **Herman Miller:** [hermanmiller.com](https://www.hermanmiller.com/) *(Note: Herman Miller and Knoll have merged to form MillerKnoll, but operate separate sites).*
*   **Haworth:** [haworth.com](https://www.haworth.com/)
*   **Knoll:** [knoll.com](https://www.knoll.com/)

### 2. High-Quality Ergonomic & Mid-Market Brands
These brands offer excellent commercial-grade furniture that is highly focused on human health, posture, or practical corporate solutions.
*   **Humanscale:** [humanscale.com](https://www.humanscale.com/) (Famous for hyper-ergonomic chairs and monitor arms).
*   **HON:** [hon.com](https://www.hon.com/) (Great mid-market brand for traditional and modern office setups).
*   **Global Furniture Group:** [globalfurnituregroup.com](https://www.globalfurnituregroup.com/)
*   **Kimball International:** [kimballinternational.com](https://www.kimballinternational.com/)

### 3. Direct-to-Consumer (Great for Home Offices & Startups)
These brands bypass traditional dealerships. They are highly popular for work-from-home setups, offering modern aesthetics and good value.
*   **Branch:** [branchfurniture.com](https://www.branchfurniture.com/) (Highly rated for sleek, affordable ergonomic chairs and desks).
*   **Poppin:** [poppin.com](https://www.poppin.com/) (Known for colorful, modern, and easy-to-assemble office furniture).
*   **Laura Davidson:** [lauradavidsondirect.com](https://www.lauradavidsondirect.com/) (Known for affordable replicas of mid-century modern office furniture).

### 4. Standing Desk & Active Workspace Specialists
If your primary goal is a sit-stand desk or active seating, these are the industry favorites.
*   **Uplift Desk:** [upliftdesk.com](https://www.upliftdesk.com/) (Highly customizable standing desks).
*   **Vari (formerly Varidesk):** [vari.com](https://www.vari.com/) (Famous for desktop converters, now sells full office suites).
*   **Autonomous:** [autonomous.ai](https://www.autonomous.ai/) (Tech-focused, modern standing desks and ergonomic chairs).
*   **Fully:** *(Note: Fully was acquired by Herman Miller. Their popular Jarvis desk can now be found on the Herman Miller and Design Within Reach websites).*

### 5. Budget & General Retail
If you need to outfit an office on a strict budget.
*   **IKEA (Workspace):** [ikea.com](https://www.ikea.com/) (Look for their "IKEA for Business" section for commercial-rated items).
*   **Wayfair Professional:** [wayfair.com](https://www.wayfair.com/) (Vast selection of budget-to-mid-range third-party brands).
*   **National Business Furniture:** [nationalbusinessfurniture.com](https://www.nationalbusinessfurniture.com/) (A massive distributor of various budget and mid-tier brands).

**A quick tip:** If you are buying for a *home office*, you can buy directly from almost all of these websites. If you are buying for a *large corporate office*, look for the "For Business" or "Find a Dealer" tabs on sites like Steelcase or Herman Miller, as they offer heavy discounts for bulk/B2B purchases through authorized local dealers.
